costs.download_cache: all pinned archives pre-existing on disk; 0 new bytes fetched by this run; subset/full sizes below are on-disk pinned bytes, not new ingress

eligibility.rule: parseable + neutral + elements subset of {C,H,O,N,F} + heavy<=9 via existing typed-graph standardizer

exact_match.exact_graph_identity_gate: COMPLETE for C7H10O2 subset scope; broader QM9 scope only when full archive scanned
exact_match.level: EXACT typed-graph connectivity identity (relaxed primary, GDB separate); formula/weak-fp presence never counts
exact_match.pool_injection: none (no target injected into any candidate pool)

source_identity_mismatch.policy: relaxed-geometry SMILES/InChI is the evidence structure; GDB-input strings reported separately; mismatches counted, never silently merged

train_fit.exclusion_policy: unresolved_subset_numbering (subset-local indices cannot join full-GDB9 exclusion list; no excluded geometry silently claimed)
train_fit.match_policy: relaxed-geometry SMILES is primary physical evidence; GDB-input SMILES reported separately; formula/weak-fingerprint presence never counts as a match

exact_match.train_note: physical-evidence presence audit only; no spectral scoring, hence no train-contamination concern; declared explicitly

val.exclusion_policy: unresolved_subset_numbering (subset-local indices cannot join full-GDB9 exclusion list; no excluded geometry silently claimed)
val.match_policy: relaxed-geometry SMILES is primary physical evidence; GDB-input SMILES reported separately; formula/weak-fingerprint presence never counts as a match

exclusion_policy.detail: C7H10O2 subset uses consecutive subset-local numbering 1..6095; uncharacterized.txt uses full-GDB9 numbering 1..133885. No member is excluded on a cross-numbering join; members failing local validation are counted separately.

frequency_evidence.incomplete_count_note: exact geometry identity retained; incomplete mode counts NEVER counted as positive-only stationary-point evidence
frequency_evidence.interpretation: complete-count all-positive harmonic frequencies on exactly matched relaxed geometries are RESTRICTED physical evidence of a stationary point, NOT kinetic lifetime/solution stability; zero/ negative/incomplete counts reported separately when present
frequency_evidence.stationary_point_note: subset exclusion unresolved: no subset row may serve as positive control
frequency_evidence.subset_scope: exclusion_unresolved: subset members CANNOT contribute positive-control frequency evidence; counts below are identity bookkeeping only, with stationary-point evidence forced to zero

exact_match_train_fit.stationary_point_note: complete-count all-positive members only; incomplete/zero/negative excluded

exact_match_val.stationary_point_note: complete-count all-positive members only; incomplete/zero/negative excluded

restricted_match.note: superseded by exact_match; weak formula presence retired, never claimed as physical evidence

cite: Blum & Reymond, JACS 131:8732 (2009); Ruddigkeit et al., JCIM 52:2864 (2012)
source.method: B3LYP/6-31G(2df,p) geometry + harmonic frequencies (per official dataset page)

stability_claim: NONE: a matched optimized geometry is restricted evidence, NOT kinetic lifetime/solution stability
